title: The War of Halves
summary: The painting told a war: the sky against the fire, a god against himself. Show the gilded stone to someone old enough to know the stories.

goals.say: 'Two halves of the same god fought once,' the elder says, turning the stone over. 'The sky half won the sky. The fire half got everything else.'
goals.name: Village Elder

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: Is that gilded blackstone? From a bastion? My grandfather had a piece. He called it the sun's scar.
talk: Neither. That's the trouble with a war against yourself. Both sides lose, and both sides have to live with it.
Is that why he's only half a god?
Half in the sky, half in the fire, and the cult trying to glue him back together with gold. Yes. I think so.
